ens_xgb_best.hypothesis: Outputs of 'ens_xgb_best' give a lower loss than production on the task(s) where they were better in 2026/27 and a Main ROI not lower than production's on future matches.
ens_xgb_best.primary_metric: paired loss difference vs production on the improved task(s) (1X2 log loss / Poisson deviance); secondary: paired Main ROI difference (close)
ens_xgb_best.minimum_forward_sample: 1000 played matches (about 2.5 months of the 21 leagues)
